CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.employment_adoption_prepared_sources_v1(p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx jsonb;records jsonb;n integer;invalid_tuple boolean;distinct_revisions integer;distinct_profiles integer;
BEGIN
 ctx:=public.native_employee_context_v1(p);
 IF NOT public.action_center_context_has_capability(ctx,'workforce.employee.read') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPLOYMENT_ADOPTION_FORBIDDEN';
 END IF;
 PERFORM public.municipal_adoption_ready_v1();
 SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT r.id),count(DISTINCT r.source_profile),
  coalesce(bool_or(((((r.source_profile = 'grh-junin-2026-10-01'::text) AND (r.source_sha256 = '50a4cc2673be5e275dc5850aa8779f46de82dd81733a87e4b2cfa2aec49e025f'::text) AND (r.source_cutoff = '2026-10-01 15:17:29'::timestamp without time zone)) OR ((r.source_profile = 'grh-junin-2026-10-14'::text) AND (r.source_sha256 = '3efa61a77e5b160dff14dbb53a3634054dbc70a284c3f5101acd98ee9b5aecf4'::text) AND (r.source_cutoff = '2026-10-14 15:18:17'::timestamp without time zone)) OR ((r.source_profile = 'grh-junin-2026-10-28'::text) AND (r.source_sha256 = 'fef5aada3142e475d0519f7647377465d95ee55b4038aff035ff7d41d5748cc1'::text) AND (r.source_cutoff = '2026-10-28 15:16:35'::timestamp without time zone)))) IS NOT TRUE),false),
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('revisionId',r.id,'packageSha256',r.package_sha256,
   'cutoff',to_char(r.source_cutoff,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY r.source_cutoff DESC,r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO n,distinct_revisions,distinct_profiles,invalid_tuple,records
 FROM public.grh_final_source_revision r
 JOIN public.grh_final_source_seal seal ON seal.revision_id=r.id
 JOIN public.grh_effective_source_binding selected ON selected.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
  AND selected.source_binding_id=r.source_binding_id AND selected.source_version_id=r.parent_core_version_id
  AND selected.publication_sha256=r.parent_publication_sha256
 WHERE r.tenant_id=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid AND r.source_binding_id=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid;
 IF n>3 OR invalid_tuple OR distinct_revisions<>n OR distinct_profiles<>n THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'EMPLOYMENT_ADOPTION_SOURCE_CHANGED';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('version','employment-adoption-prepared-sources.v1',
  'scope',jsonb_build_object('tenantId',ctx->>'tenantId','membershipId',ctx->>'membershipId',
   'bindingId',ctx->>'sourceBindingId','companyId',(ctx->>'sourceCompanyId')::integer),
  'total',n,'rows',records);
END
$function$
